name: 70435 · Covington, LA
findings: ZIP 70435 (Covington) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70435 (Covington) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
